verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an API gateway configured through code (providerOptions), dashboards, and a CLI setup command. Nothing shows the gateway itself being operated or configured through natural-language commands. Routing natural-language prompts to models, connecting coding agents to the gateway as a model provider, and publishing llms.txt or markdown docs are adjacent features, not natural-language operation of the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
